title: hymenocallis caribaea f. angustifolia

This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
